description: This file declares the interface for managing OCSP (Online Certificate Status Protocol) responses within the lighttpd server, including functions for creating, freeing, using, loading, and searching OCSP responses.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_new
methods.description: Creates a new instance of LiGnuTLSOCSP.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_free
methods.description: Frees the memory associated with an OCSP object.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_use
methods.description: Associates an OCSP object with specific gnutls certificate credentials.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_add
methods.description: Loads an OCSP response from a file in DER or PEM format and adds it to the server context.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_search
methods.description: Searches a PEM file for an OCSP response block and adds it if found.

methods.name: li_gnutls_ocsp_search_datum
methods.description: Searches a gnutls_datum_t data blob for an OCSP response block and adds it if found.
